تتصاعدوا (form VI)
# تَتَصَاعَدُوا (tataṣāʕadū) /ta.ta.sˤaː.ʕa.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَصَاعَدَ (taṣāʕada)
# تُتَصَاعَدُوا (tutaṣāʕadū) /tu.ta.sˤaː.ʕa.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَصَاعَدَ (taṣāʕada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
